name: system
title: System
description: Sleep, lock, log out, restart, shut down, empty the trash, dark mode, volume, brightness, do not disturb, eject, show desktop, keep awake (for a while, until a time, or while an app runs, with a countdown on the bar), quit or unhide every app, dismiss notifications. Quick Look on the Finder selection.
author: pal

settings.label: Ask first
settings.text: Confirm before logging out, restarting, shutting down, emptying the trash or quitting every app
settings.description: Log Out, Restart, Shut Down, Empty Trash and Quit All Apps show a confirmation first; off runs them at once.

settings.label: Keep awake for
settings.description: What a bare Keep Awake runs for: 45m, 2h, 1h30m, a clock time like 14:30, or forever.

settings.label: Display
settings.description: On: neither the machine nor the display sleeps (caffeinate -d -i). Off: the display may sleep while the machine stays up, for a download or a build. The row's Display field and the popover's switch override it per run.

store.tagline: Sleep, lock, restart, dark mode, volume, keep awake
features: Indexed rows with keywords, so `mute`, `sleep` or `power off` at the root finds the command
Only what this machine can run is listed: Brightness needs the `brightness` CLI on macOS, Do Not Disturb a Shortcut named "Toggle Do Not Disturb"
Empty Trash shows what is in the Trash on the right (`3 items`, `empty`); Toggle Dark Mode carries the current appearance as a tag

Keep Awake takes how long in the bar (`45m`, `2h`, `14:30`, `forever`; blank is the default), `cmd+enter` keeps awake until turned off, `cmd+u` opens a form for a time, an app to follow and the display; the row reads Allow Sleep with the time left while a run is on

A bar item with a coffee glyph and the countdown (∞ without an end), hidden while off; its popover has the presets on the digits, the display switch and Allow sleep. `caffeinate` (or `systemd-inhibit`) does the timing itself, so the run ends on time even with pal down, and a restarted pal finds it again by its pid

Quit All Apps closes every open app but Finder and pal (each asked the way its Quit menu asks, so unsaved work still prompts), Unhide All Apps brings hidden ones back, Dismiss Notifications clears what is on screen (Notification Center over Accessibility on macOS; the daemon's CLI on Linux)
Log Out, Restart, Shut Down, Empty Trash and Quit All Apps ask first, unless `confirm_destructive` is off

Quick Look Finder Selection (macOS): the Quick Look panel over what is marked in Finder, the names as the subtitle; the row is inert and says why while nothing is selected or Finder is not in front. `pal://system/run?id=quick-look-selection` for a hotkey
pal hides before running, so the command lands on the desktop, not on pal; a failure keeps the panel open with the tool's message

awake.title: Keep Awake
awake.description: A coffee glyph and what is left of the run (∞ without an end), a monitor mark when the display is kept awake too; hidden while off (`show = "always"` keeps a muted coffee). The popover: the run on a card with the time left and a bar, the presets as tiles on the digits, the display switch, Allow sleep on Enter; `u` opens a field for a time or a duration.
